title: Tech View cells show a blue number, a thin progress bar and the advisor's avatar
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A} (for example Admin ShopView), an Owner or Admin user whose role has Work orders > View, Work orders > Create & Edit and See financial data, at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is 1440 px wide, with the browser zoom at 100%.
  • The design picture DC-05-tech-view-rows-regular-light-1440.png is open beside the app at 100% zoom (actual size); it is attached to this case.
  • In the design pictures the names, numbers, dates and amounts are sample data, and the rank numbers (1, 2, 3 …) beside rows and cards are left out of this release, so do not compare those.
  • Technician {Technician-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST DC05 Eva Cells) is an active technician at {Location-A} who has a profile photo.
  • Technician {Technician-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST DC05 Finn Cells) is an active technician at {Location-A} who has no profile photo.
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST DC05 Cell Styles") is used by this case only.
  • Approved work order {Work-order-1} (for example S10043-17812) for {Customer-A} is led by {Technician-A}, has a service advisor shown in List, and has one approved line, {Line-1} (for example "Service - Full grease service"), whose technician is {Technician-B}.
  • {Technician-B} is clocked in to {Line-1}, so List's Clocked In column shows a name for {Work-order-1}.
  • Work order {Work-order-2} (for example S10043-17813) for {Customer-A} is Invoiced and led by {Technician-A}.
  • On the Work Orders page nothing is chosen in any filter, Assigned to me is off, Search is empty and density is Regular (the default).
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and click Tech View in the display switcher.
  2. Find {Work-order-1}'s row in {Technician-A}'s group.
  3. Look at the Number cell.
  4. Look at the Progress cell.
  5. Look at the Service Advisor cell.
  6. Look at the Assigned Techs cell.
  7. Look at the Waiting On Parts, Clocked In and Total price cells.
  8. Hover the first avatar in the Assigned Techs cell, then the second.
  9. Click {Work-order-1}'s number.
  10. Go back to the Work Orders page.
  11. Look at {Work-order-2}'s Number cell.
  12. Hover the small padlock next to {Work-order-2}'s number.
  13. Click List in the display switcher.
  14. Look at {Work-order-1}'s Clocked In cell.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: the number shows in the blue used for links, the same blue as the numbers in the design picture, not in black.
  • Step 4: a thin rounded bar with the percentage beside it in small grey text (for example 0%), as in the picture: in the design the bar is 64 × 6 px, about as long as the word "Progress" in the header and much thinner than the text. Any filled part of the bar is blue.
  • Step 5: a small round avatar sits before the advisor's name: the advisor's photo, or the initials on a light-grey circle.
  • Step 6: overlapping round avatars, {Technician-A} (the lead) first, then {Technician-B}.
  • Step 7: Waiting On Parts shows a grey dash (-), not a blank, and Total price sits at the right of its column.
  • Step 8: each avatar shows its technician's name when hovered.
  • Step 9: the work order opens.
  • Step 11: a small padlock outline icon sits right after {Work-order-2}'s number, as after the S1-359 and S1-360 numbers in the design picture.
  • Step 12: a dark tooltip with light text opens above the padlock.
  • Step 14: List's Clocked In cell shows the same thing in the same style as Tech View's Clocked In cell at step 7.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; stories SV-10045 (Story 2, Tech View), SV-10044 (Story 1, Switch between display options), SV-10050 (Story 7, Line technicians); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 52 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S2-R20, S1-R9a, S2-R8, S7-R3 and S7-R6, read 14 Oct 2026; Claude Design project "Work Orders" (Branko Cicovic), export of 14 Oct 2026, board "Work Orders.dc.html", state core__work-orders__tech-regular__light__1440 (design pictures DC-05-tech-view-rows-regular-light-1440.png, rendered from that export at the width in the name), read 14 Oct 2026. Covers the design defects SV-11325 (reported 14 Oct 2026 by Chris Ward), SV-11319 (reported 14 Oct 2026 by Chris Ward). Where the PRD says nothing about the look, the design is the source. Source-verified 14 October 2026. Not yet checked against a build.

The design shows Clocked In as a time badge (for example 0:48); this case follows the PRD, which keeps List's display (question W-16 to the product owner, not yet answered). The design also locks Declined and Imported work orders; this case checks the padlock on an Invoiced one only.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R20: “Tech View’s cells follow the design: the work order number shows as a link in the accent color; Progress shows as a thin bar with the percentage beside it; Service Advisor shows the advisor’s avatar before the name. Clocked In keeps List’s display (S5-R11).”
  • S1-R9a: “The switcher uses the design’s icons at 20px: List is Lucide `list`, Tech View is `user-round`, Board View is `square-kanban`. In Tech View and Board View every other icon is the design’s Lucide icon too: density (`row-height` in Tech View, `card-height` in Board View), collapse chevron (`chevron-down`), pin and unpin (`pin` / `pin-off`), Invoiced or Paid lock (`lock`), Unassigned avatar (`user-round`) and empty states (`clipboard-list`). List’s icons are unchanged.”
  • S2-R8: “Clicking anywhere on a row, outside its own controls, opens the work order. A drag starts only after the pointer has moved a few pixels, so a click never turns into a drag.”
  • S7-R3: “Place the lead technician first in the avatar group.”
  • S7-R6: “Keep every involved technician discoverable by name.”
  • Design — Work Orders.dc.html, Tech View Progress cell, bar size at Regular: “barW: rowDensity === "small" ? "48px" : "64px"”
  • Design — Work Orders.dc.html, Tech View Progress cell, bar size at Regular: “barH: rowDensity === "small" ? "4px" : "6px"”
  • Design — Work Orders.dc.html, Tech View Progress cell: “font-size: 12px; color: var(--sv-text-secondary); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;">{{ wo.pctLabel }}”
  • Design — Work Orders.dc.html, Tech View Service Advisor cell: “component-from-global-scope="SVAvatarFix" name="{{ wo.adv }}" size="{{ crewSize }}"”
  • Design — Work Orders.dc.html, empty cell: “<span style="color: var(--sv-text-muted);">-</span>”
  • Design — Work Orders.dc.html, Total price cell: “text-align: right; color: var(--sv-text-primary); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;">{{ wo.total }}”
  • Design — Work Orders.dc.html, tooltip: “transform: translate(-50%, -100%); padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: var(--sv-radius-md); background: var(--sv-surface-inverse);”
